Click to drop training points; a CART de.zh: 点击以放置训练点；一棵 CART 决策树实时生长出与坐标轴对齐的划分。调整深度、划分准则、叶节点最小样本数；观察决策边界如何从过于简单变为对样本点过拟合。随后在同一数据集上与逻辑回归及 25 棵树的随机森林作比较。
Click to drop training points; a CART de.src:
Click to drop training points; a CART decision tree grows
          axis-aligned splits live. Adjust depth, split criterion,
          minimum leaf size; watch the boundary go from too-simple to
          overfit-to-points. Then compare to logistic regression and
          a 25-tree random forest on the same dataset.

@@T0@@~16 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Cla.zh:
@@T0@@约 16 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@经典机器学习 · CART · 随机森林@@T3@@

Why trees are the boring-and-good defaul.zh: 为何决策树是乏味却可靠的默认选择
Why trees are the boring-and-good defaul.src: Why trees are the boring-and-good default

For tabular data — financial features, s.zh: 对于表格数据——金融特征、传感器日志、问卷回答，凡是以 CSV 列的形式呈现的一切——决策树（或其集成）几乎总是要么正确答案，要么正确的基线。它们能处理缺失值、连续与类别混合的特征，以及任意特征的单调变换，且无需归一化。它们的归纳偏置是“在与坐标轴对齐的区域上给出常数预测”，这与人工整理的特征实际承载信息的方式出乎意料地契合。
For tabular data — financial features, s.src:
For tabular data — financial features, sensor logs, survey
          responses, anything that arrives as columns in a CSV — a
          decision tree (or its ensembles) is almost always either the
          right answer or the right baseline. They handle missing values,
          mixed continuous + categorical features, and arbitrary
          monotone transformations of any feature, without
          normalisation. Their inductive bias is "constant predictions
          on axis-aligned regions," which lines up surprisingly well
          with how human-curated features actually carry information.

The catch: a @@T0@@single@@T1@@ tree is.zh: 问题在于：@@T0@@单棵@@T1@@树过于贪婪、也过于参差不齐。解决方案——bagging（随机森林）与 boosting（XGBoost）——正是这一家族得以主宰表格数据竞赛的原因。本文聚焦于单棵树的机制，以便理解集成方法。
The catch: a @@T0@@single@@T1@@ tree is.src: The catch: a single tree is too greedy and too jagged. The fix — bagging (random forests) and boosting (XGBoost) — is what makes the family dominate tabular competitions. This article focuses on the single-tree mechanism so the ensemble methods make sense.

A CART decision tree builds itself top-d.zh: CART 决策树自顶向下构建自身。在每个节点，它选取使子节点不纯度@@T0@@下降@@T1@@最多的（特征, 阈值）组合。分类任务中标准的不纯度度量有：
A CART decision tree builds itself top-d.src: A CART decision tree builds itself top-down. At each node, it picks the (feature, threshold) pair that maximally decreases the impurity of the children. Standard impurities for classification:

For a candidate split, the impurity drop.zh: 对某个候选划分，不纯度下降量为 $\Delta = I(\text{parent}) - \frac{N_L}{N}I(\text{left}) - \frac{N_R}{N}I(\text{right})$。遍历所有特征与所有候选阈值，取最大值，再对两侧递归。当某节点已纯、过小或达到深度上限时停止。
For a candidate split, the impurity drop.src:
For a candidate split, the impurity drop is
          $\Delta = I(\text{parent}) - \frac{N_L}{N}I(\text{left}) - \frac{N_R}{N}I(\text{right})$.
          Search over all features and all candidate thresholds, pick
          the maximum, recurse on each side. Stop when a node is pure,
          too small, or hits the depth limit.

Two consequences worth feeling: (1) spli.zh: 有两点后果值得体会：（1）划分@@T0@@与坐标轴对齐@@T1@@——由此得到的决策区域是若干矩形的并集。（2）该算法是@@T2@@贪婪的@@T3@@——可能存在全局更优的划分序列，但它不会被找到。
Two consequences worth feeling: (1) spli.src: Two consequences worth feeling: (1) splits are axis-aligned — the resulting decision regions are unions of rectangles. (2) the algorithm is greedy — a globally-better split sequence may exist but won't be found.

Live: information gain across thresholds.zh: 实时演示：信息增益随阈值的变化

Drag the slider to pick a candidate thre.zh: 拖动滑块，在单个特征上选取一个候选阈值。两个直方图展示父节点（上方）如何划分为左/右子节点，下方的曲线展示不纯度下降量 $\Delta$ 随每一个可能阈值的变化。决策树取 argmax。
Drag the slider to pick a candidate thre.src:
Drag the slider to pick a candidate threshold on a single
          feature. The two histograms show how the parent (top) splits
          into left/right children, and the curve below shows the
          impurity-decrease $\Delta$ over every possible threshold. The
          tree picks the argmax.

Top: data on the feature axis. Middle: i.zh: 上方：特征轴上的数据。中部：不纯度曲线。标记 = 当前阈值。
Top: data on the feature axis. Middle: i.src: Top: data on the feature axis. Middle: impurity curve. Marker = current threshold.

The curve is @@T0@@piecewise-constant@@T.zh: 这条曲线是@@T0@@分段常数@@T1@@的：在两个相邻训练点之间移动阈值，既不获得也不损失信息。实用的 CART 实现只评估相邻排序特征值之间的中点。
The curve is @@T0@@piecewise-constant@@T.src: The curve is piecewise-constant: between two adjacent training points, no information is gained or lost by moving the threshold. Practical CART implementations only evaluate the midpoints between adjacent sorted feature values.

Entropy and Gini agree almost always on.zh: 熵与 Gini 在 argmax 上几乎总是一致——在真实数据上差异至多约 2%。Gini 是 sklearn 的默认选择，因为其计算略为廉价。
Entropy and Gini agree almost always on.src:
Entropy and Gini agree almost always on the argmax — they
            differ by at most ~2% on real data. Gini is the default in
            sklearn because it's slightly cheaper to compute.

The argmax can be very close to a tie. T.zh: argmax 可能非常接近平局。训练数据上极微小的变化就会翻转哪个特征胜出——这正是促使人们采用随机森林的@@T0@@不稳定性@@T1@@。
The argmax can be very close to a tie. T.src: The argmax can be very close to a tie. Tiny changes in training data flip which feature wins — this is the instability that motivates random forests.

Build a tree, click by click.zh: 一次一点击地构建一棵树
Build a tree, click by click.src: Build a tree, click by click

Left-click to add a class-A point (blue).zh: 左键点击添加一个 A 类点（蓝色），右键点击 / 按住 Shift 点击添加 B 类点（橙色）。每次点击后树都会重新拟合。增大@@T0@@最大深度@@T1@@；观察边界变得越来越零碎。增大@@T2@@叶节点最小样本数@@T3@@；观察它变得平滑。
Left-click to add a class-A point (blue).src: Left-click to add a class-A point (blue), right-click / shift-click for class-B (orange). The tree re-fits at every click. Push max depth up; watch the boundary become increasingly fragmented. Push min samples per leaf up; watch it smooth out.

Seed XOR / spirals.zh: 载入 XOR / 螺旋数据

Tree shape (BFS layout).zh: 树的结构（广度优先布局）

@@T0@@Axis-aligned everything.@@T1@@ Eve.zh: @@T0@@一切都与坐标轴对齐。@@T1@@ 即便你看到的“斜向”边界，也是由竖切与横切构成的阶梯。这正是决策树在旋转数据上吃力的原因——特征工程 / 旋转嵌入会有所帮助。
@@T0@@Axis-aligned everything.@@T1@@ Eve.src: Axis-aligned everything. Even the "diagonal" boundaries you see are staircases of vertical and horizontal cuts. This is why decision trees struggle with rotated data — feature engineering / rotated embeddings help.

@@T0@@Depth ⇆ overfitting.@@T1@@ At dept.zh: @@T0@@深度 ⇆ 过拟合。@@T1@@ 深度为 1 时，树只是一条带阈值的直线；深度为 8 时，每个训练点都各占一个叶节点。合适的深度取决于数据有多嘈杂。
@@T0@@Depth ⇆ overfitting.@@T1@@ At dept.src: Depth ⇆ overfitting. At depth 1 the tree is just a thresholded line; at depth 8 every training point sits in its own leaf. The right depth depends on how noisy the data is.

@@T0@@Min-samples-per-leaf is the cleane.zh:
@@T0@@叶节点最小样本数是最干净的正则化手段。@@T1@@
            设为 5 会迫使树忽略单点离群值；边界更干净，训练误差略高，而测试误差通常更好。
@@T0@@Min-samples-per-leaf is the cleane.src: Min-samples-per-leaf is the cleanest regulariser. Setting it to 5 forces the tree to ignore single-point outliers; cleaner boundary, slightly higher train error, usually better test error.

@@T0@@Random forest = many shallow trees.zh:
@@T0@@随机森林 = 许多浅树投票。@@T1@@
            每棵树看到的是一个自助采样样本，且每次划分只考虑随机的一部分特征。在相近的准确率下，25 棵树的集成比单棵深树平滑得多。这正是它成为日常表格数据主力工具的原因。
@@T0@@Random forest = many shallow trees.src: Random forest = many shallow trees voted. Each tree sees a bootstrap sample and a random subset of features per split. The 25-tree ensemble is much smoother than a single deep tree at similar accuracy. This is why it's the everyday tabular workhorse.

@@T0@@Logistic regression = one straight.zh:
@@T0@@逻辑回归 = 一条直线。@@T1@@
            在 XOR 形数据上表现最差，而在高维但近乎线性的表格任务上常常最佳。
@@T0@@Logistic regression = one straight.src: Logistic regression = one straight line. Worst on XOR-shaped data, often best on high-dimensional-but-near-linear tabular tasks.

The same recipe works for regression: re.zh: 同一套配方也适用于回归：把 Gini/熵替换为平方误差不纯度
The same recipe works for regression: re.src:
The same recipe works for regression: replace Gini/entropy
          with squared-error impurity

At each leaf, predict the @@T0@@mean@@T1.zh: 在每个叶节点，预测落入该处的训练 $y$ 值的@@T0@@均值@@T1@@。结果是 $x$ 的分段常数函数——对平滑信号很糟糕（应改用 GP），但对正确的水平集本身就是分段常数的表格特征却极为合适。
At each leaf, predict the @@T0@@mean@@T1.src: At each leaf, predict the mean of the training $y$ values that fell there. The result is a piecewise-constant function of $x$ — terrible for smooth signals (use a GP), but excellent for tabular features where the right level set is itself piecewise-constant.

A subtlety: the split criterion for regr.zh: 一个微妙之处：回归的划分准则等价于在划分处最大化@@T0@@组间方差@@T1@@——即一种与坐标轴对齐的方差分析（ANOVA）。这解释了为何回归树能找出线性模型所遗漏的阈值效应（例如“超过 65 mph 后，燃油经济性急剧下降”）。
A subtlety: the split criterion for regr.src: A subtlety: the split criterion for regression is equivalent to maximising the between-group variance at the split — i.e. an axis-aligned ANOVA. This explains why regression trees can find threshold-effects (e.g. "above 65 mph, fuel economy drops sharply") that linear models miss.

Pruning &amp; the cost-complexity path.zh: 剪枝与代价复杂度路径

Pre-pruning (depth limit, min-samples-pe.zh: 预剪枝（深度上限、叶节点最小样本数）廉价但粗糙。后剪枝则更有原则：先长成一棵完整的树，再合并那些不划算的子树。CART 的代价复杂度准则为：
Pre-pruning (depth limit, min-samples-pe.src:
Pre-pruning (depth limit, min-samples-per-leaf) is cheap but
          coarse. Post-pruning is principled: grow a full tree, then
          collapse subtrees that don't pay for themselves. CART's
          cost-complexity criterion:

As $\\alpha$ increases from 0 to $\\inft.zh: 当 $\alpha$ 从 0 增至 $\infty$ 时，最优树从完整的树收缩至根节点。@@T0@@代价复杂度路径@@T1@@就是你途经的那一串树；挑选 $\alpha$ 的推荐方法是在这条路径上做交叉验证。
As $\\alpha$ increases from 0 to $\\inft.src: As $\alpha$ increases from 0 to $\infty$, the optimal tree shrinks from the full tree to the root. The cost-complexity path is the sequence of trees you pass through; the recommended way to pick $\alpha$ is cross-validation on this path.

scikit-learn exposes this via\n.zh: scikit-learn 通过 @@T0@@DecisionTreeClassifier(ccp_alpha=α)@@T1@@ 与 @@T2@@cost_complexity_pruning_path@@T3@@ 暴露了这一功能。

Boosted trees rarely use post-pruning —.zh: 提升树很少使用后剪枝——小深度 + 大量树以更简单的簿记达到了类似效果。
Boosted trees rarely use post-pruning —.src:
Boosted trees rarely use post-pruning — small depth +
            many trees gives a similar effect with simpler bookkeeping.

Two ways to score feature importance fro.zh: 从已拟合的树中评估特征重要度有两种方式：
Two ways to score feature importance fro.src: Two ways to score feature importance from a fitted tree:

@@T0@@MDI (Mean Decrease in Impurity).@@.zh: @@T0@@MDI（平均不纯度下降）。@@T1@@ 对有该特征参与划分的每个节点，累加其加权的 不纯度下降量。廉价，是 sklearn 的默认方法——但会@@T2@@偏向@@T3@@高基数特征（可能的阈值越多 = 越有机会找到一个虚假的划分）。
@@T0@@MDI (Mean Decrease in Impurity).@@.src: MDI (Mean Decrease in Impurity). Sum the weighted impurity decrease over every node that split on that feature. Cheap, default in sklearn — but biased towards high-cardinality features (more possible thresholds = more chances to find a spurious split).

@@T0@@Permutation importance.@@T1@@ Shuf.zh: @@T0@@置换重要度。@@T1@@ 在验证集上打乱某个特征，测量准确率的下降。较慢但无偏；对于任何要离开实验室的“哪些特征重要”的主张，都推荐使用它。
@@T0@@Permutation importance.@@T1@@ Shuf.src: Permutation importance. Shuffle a feature on the validation set, measure the accuracy drop. Slower but unbiased; recommended for any "which features matter" claim that leaves the lab.

@@T0@@SHAP TreeExplainer.@@T1@@ Exact Sh.zh: @@T0@@SHAP TreeExplainer。@@T1@@ 对树集成在多项式时间内精确计算 Shapley 值（Lundberg 等人，2018）。逐预测归因的正确工具；开箱即用于 XGBoost / LightGBM。
@@T0@@SHAP TreeExplainer.@@T1@@ Exact Sh.src: SHAP TreeExplainer. Exact Shapley values for tree ensembles in polynomial time (Lundberg et al., 2018). The right tool for per-prediction attribution; works for XGBoost / LightGBM out of the box.

What trees are good at — and what they'r.zh: 决策树擅长什么——以及不擅长什么
What trees are good at — and what they'r.src: What trees are good at — and what they're not

@@T0@@Tabular features, mixed types.@@T1.zh: @@T0@@表格特征、混合类型。@@T1@@ 决策树无需归一化即可处理类别与数值特征。任何表格任务的默认首选方案。
@@T0@@Tabular features, mixed types.@@T1.src: Tabular features, mixed types. Trees handle categorical and numeric features without normalisation. The default first try on any tabular task.

@@T0@@Interpretability per prediction.@@.zh:
@@T0@@逐预测的可解释性。@@T1@@
            “预测为 A 类，因为特征 X > 3.2 且特征 Y < 0.7”——决策树免费给你这条路径。对于可解释系统与审计很有用。
@@T0@@Interpretability per prediction.@@.src: Interpretability per prediction. "Predicted class A because feature X > 3.2 and feature Y < 0.7" — a tree gives you that path for free. Useful for explainable systems and audits.

@@T0@@Strong ensembles.@@T1@@ Random For.zh: @@T0@@强大的集成。@@T1@@ Random Forest、ExtraTrees、梯度提升树、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost——它们至今仍惯常赢得 Kaggle 表格竞赛。
@@T0@@Strong ensembles.@@T1@@ Random For.src: Strong ensembles. Random Forest, ExtraTrees, Gradient Boosted Trees, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost — all still routinely win Kaggle tabular competitions.

@@T0@@Bad at:@@T1@@ high-dimensional spa.zh: @@T0@@不擅长的方面：@@T1@@ 高维稀疏数据（文本、图像）、平滑的低维回归（应改用 GP）、训练范围之外的外推（决策树字面上无法预测超出训练集 min/max 的值）。
@@T0@@Bad at:@@T1@@ high-dimensional spa.src: Bad at: high-dimensional sparse data (text, images), smooth low-dim regression (use a GP), extrapolation outside training range (a tree literally cannot predict beyond min/max in training).

@@T0@@Inductive bias.@@T1@@ Strong axis-.zh: @@T0@@归纳偏置。@@T1@@ 强烈偏向与坐标轴对齐的阶梯。如果你的真实决策边界是一个球面或已被旋转，你就需要旋转后的特征，或更平滑的模型。
@@T0@@Inductive bias.@@T1@@ Strong axis-.src: Inductive bias. Strong axis-aligned staircase prior. If your true decision boundary is a sphere or rotated, you need rotated features or a smoother model.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A sin.zh:
@@T0@@这句口号。@@T1@@
          单棵决策树很少是答案；树的集成则常常是。那类（梯度提升的）集成正是@@T2@@XGBoost 一文@@T3@@接下来所讨论的内容。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A sin.src: The slogan. A single decision tree is rarely the answer; an ensemble of trees often is. That ensemble (gradient-boosted) is what the XGBoost article covers next.

@@T0@@ID3 (Quinlan, 1986)@@T1@@ — entrop.zh: @@T0@@ID3（Quinlan, 1986）@@T1@@——熵准则；仅支持类别特征；每个类别取值一个节点。属历史算法；如今很少直接使用。
@@T0@@ID3 (Quinlan, 1986)@@T1@@ — entrop.src: ID3 (Quinlan, 1986) — entropy criterion; categorical features only; one node per category value. Historical; rarely used directly today.

@@T0@@C4.5 (Quinlan, 1993)@@T1@@ — adds.zh: @@T0@@C4.5（Quinlan, 1993）@@T1@@——加入连续特征（划分 = 阈值）；用@@T2@@增益率@@T3@@取代信息增益以对抗对高基数特征的偏向；内建缺失值处理。
@@T0@@C4.5 (Quinlan, 1993)@@T1@@ — adds.src: C4.5 (Quinlan, 1993) — adds continuous features (split = threshold); replaces information gain with gain ratio to fight bias toward high-cardinality features; built-in missing-value handling.

@@T0@@CART (Breiman et&nbsp;al., 1984)@@.zh: @@T0@@CART（Breiman 等人，1984）@@T1@@——仅做二叉划分；分类用 Gini，回归用平方误差；代价复杂度剪枝。它是 scikit-learn 与大多数现代库的默认实现。
@@T0@@CART (Breiman et&nbsp;al., 1984)@@.src: CART (Breiman et al., 1984) — binary splits only; Gini for classification, squared error for regression; cost-complexity pruning. The default in scikit-learn and most modern libraries.

@@T0@@Conditional inference trees@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@条件推断树@@T1@@（Hothorn 等人，2006）——用独立性统计检验取代不纯度准则；消除了对多水平特征的偏向。即 R 的 @@T2@@party@@T3@@ 包。
@@T0@@Conditional inference trees@@T1@@.src: Conditional inference trees (Hothorn et al., 2006) — replace the impurity criterion with statistical tests of independence; eliminates the bias toward many-level features. The R party package.

@@T0@@Breiman, Friedman, Olshen, Stone (.zh:
@@T0@@Breiman, Friedman, Olshen, Stone (1984)@@T1@@
            — @@T2@@Classification and Regression Trees.@@T3@@ CART 的原始著作。
@@T0@@Breiman, Friedman, Olshen, Stone (.src: Breiman, Friedman, Olshen, Stone (1984) — Classification and Regression Trees. The original CART book.

@@T0@@Hastie, Tibshirani, Friedman@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@Hastie, Tibshirani, Friedman@@T1@@，@@T2@@The Elements of Statistical Learning@@T3@@，第 9 章——最好的“带数学的入门介绍”。
@@T0@@Hastie, Tibshirani, Friedman@@T1@@.src: Hastie, Tibshirani, Friedman, The Elements of Statistical Learning, ch. 9 — best intro-with-math.

@@T0@@Lundberg &amp; Lee (2017); Lundber.zh: @@T0@@Lundberg 与 Lee (2017)；Lundberg 等人 (2018)@@T1@@ — 用于解释的 SHAP 与 TreeSHAP。
@@T0@@Lundberg &amp; Lee (2017); Lundber.src: Lundberg & Lee (2017); Lundberg et al. (2018) — SHAP and TreeSHAP for explanation.

@@T0@@Grinsztajn, Oyallon, Varoquaux (20.zh:
@@T0@@Grinsztajn, Oyallon, Varoquaux (2022)@@T1@@
            — @@T2@@Why do tree-based models still outperform deep learning on tabular data?@@T3@@ 经验性的参考。
@@T0@@Grinsztajn, Oyallon, Varoquaux (20.src: Grinsztajn, Oyallon, Varoquaux (2022) — Why do tree-based models still outperform deep learning on tabular data? The empirical reference.

meta.title: 决策树，实时演示

meta.summary: 点击添加训练数据点；决策树实时生长，按 Gini / 熵 / 方差下降进行划分。提供最大深度与叶节点最小样本数的滑块。并排比较树的决策边界、逻辑回归与由 25 棵树构成的随机森林。
highlights: 左键/右键点击以添加 A 类 / B 类点；每次点击后树都会实时重新生长。
划分准则选择器（Gini / 熵）以及深度与最小样本数滑块。
并排比较：1 棵树 vs 由 25 棵树构成的随机森林 vs 逻辑回归。
